review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Mr Tyson counts every penny: cash and coins, what things cost and what he can afford, saving, spending and lending, the bill, the receipt and a good bargain at the market.
description.sl: Gospod Tyson šteje vsak peni: gotovina in kovanci, koliko kaj stane in kaj si lahko privošči, varčevanje, zapravljanje in posojanje, račun, potrdilo in dobra kupčija na trgu.
description.it: Il signor Tyson conta ogni penny: contanti e monete, quanto costano le cose e che cosa può permettersi, risparmiare, spendere e prestare, il conto, la ricevuta e un buon affare al mercato.
description.de: Mr Tyson zählt jeden Penny: Bargeld und Münzen, was die Dinge kosten und was er sich leisten kann, sparen, ausgeben und leihen, die Rechnung, den Kassenbon und ein gutes Schnäppchen auf dem Markt.

words.example_en: The farm shop only takes cash.
words.example_sl: Kmečka trgovina sprejema le gotovino.
words.example_it: Lo spaccio della fattoria accetta solo contanti.
words.example_de: Der Hofladen nimmt nur Bargeld.

words.example_en: Alfie keeps his coins in an old jam jar.
words.example_sl: Alfie hrani kovance v stari marmeladni posodi.
words.example_it: Alfie tiene le monete in un vecchio vasetto della marmellata.
words.example_de: Alfie bewahrt seine Münzen in einem alten Marmeladenglas auf.

words.example_en: Scottish banknotes look different, but you can use them here too.
words.example_sl: Škotski bankovci so videti drugače, a jih lahko uporabiš tudi tukaj.
words.example_it: Le banconote scozzesi sono diverse, ma si possono usare anche qui.
words.example_de: Schottische Geldscheine sehen anders aus, aber man kann sie auch hier benutzen.
words.note: In everyday British English people say a note: a ten-pound note. American bill.
words.note_sl: V vsakdanji britanski angleščini rečejo a note: a ten-pound note. Ameriško bill.
words.note_it: Nel parlato britannico si dice a note: a ten-pound note. In americano bill.
words.note_de: Im britischen Alltag sagt man a note: a ten-pound note. Amerikanisch bill.

words.example_en: The price of petrol has gone up again.
words.example_sl: Cena bencina je spet zrasla.
words.example_it: Il prezzo della benzina è salito di nuovo.
words.example_de: Der Benzinpreis ist schon wieder gestiegen.

words.example_en: How much does a pint cost at the Packhorse?
words.example_sl: Koliko stane pivo v gostilni Packhorse?
words.example_it: Quanto costa una pinta al Packhorse?
words.example_de: Was kostet ein Pint im Packhorse?
words.note: Cost, cost, cost: the past is the same.
words.note_sl: Cost, cost, cost: preteklik je enak.
words.note_it: Cost, cost, cost: il passato è uguale.
words.note_de: Cost, cost, cost: die Vergangenheit ist gleich.

words.example_en: Eggs are cheap at the farm gate: a pound for six.
words.example_sl: Jajca so pri kmetiji poceni: funt za šest.
words.example_it: Le uova sono economiche al cancello della fattoria: una sterlina per sei.
words.example_de: Eier sind am Hoftor billig: ein Pfund für sechs.

words.example_en: Houses in Grasmere are very expensive now.
words.example_sl: Hiše v Grasmeru so zdaj zelo drage.
words.example_it: Le case a Grasmere adesso sono molto care.
words.example_de: Häuser in Grasmere sind jetzt sehr teuer.

words.example_en: We can't afford a new car this year.
words.example_sl: Letos si ne moremo privoščiti novega avta.
words.example_it: Quest'anno non possiamo permetterci una macchina nuova.
words.example_de: Dieses Jahr können wir uns kein neues Auto leisten.
words.note: Afford comes with can or could: I can't afford it.
words.note_sl: Afford pride s can ali could: I can't afford it.
words.note_it: Afford va con can o could: I can't afford it.
words.note_de: Afford steht mit can oder could: I can't afford it.

words.example_en: Harry is saving for a new bike.
words.example_sl: Harry varčuje za novo kolo.
words.example_it: Harry sta risparmiando per una bici nuova.
words.example_de: Harry spart für ein neues Fahrrad.

words.example_en: She spent all her money at the Christmas market.
words.example_sl: Ves denar je porabila na božičnem sejmu.
words.example_it: Ha speso tutti i suoi soldi al mercatino di Natale.
words.example_de: Sie hat ihr ganzes Geld auf dem Weihnachtsmarkt ausgegeben.
words.note: Spend, spent, spent. You also spend time: I spent a week in Wales.
words.note_sl: Spend, spent, spent. Tudi čas: I spent a week in Wales (preživel sem).
words.note_it: Spend, spent, spent. Anche il tempo: I spent a week in Wales (ho passato).
words.note_de: Spend, spent, spent. Auch Zeit: I spent a week in Wales (verbracht).

words.example_en: Can I borrow your ladder for the weekend?
words.example_sl: Si lahko za konec tedna sposodim tvojo lestev?
words.example_it: Posso prendere in prestito la tua scala per il fine settimana?
words.example_de: Kann ich mir übers Wochenende deine Leiter leihen?
words.note: You borrow from someone; you lend to someone.
words.note_sl: Borrow from: sposoditi si od; lend to: posoditi komu.
words.note_it: Borrow from: farsi prestare da; lend to: prestare a.
words.note_de: Borrow from: sich von jemandem leihen; lend to: jemandem leihen.

words.example_en: Mr Dixon lent me his hammer, so I must give it back today.
words.example_sl: Gospod Dixon mi je posodil kladivo, zato mu ga moram danes vrniti.
words.example_it: Il signor Dixon mi ha prestato il martello, quindi devo restituirglielo oggi.
words.example_de: Mr Dixon hat mir seinen Hammer geliehen, also muss ich ihn heute zurückgeben.

words.example_en: Could we have the bill, please?
words.example_sl: Bi lahko dobili račun, prosim?
words.example_it: Ci porta il conto, per favore?
words.example_de: Könnten wir bitte die Rechnung haben?
words.note: In a restaurant British English says the bill; American the check.
words.note_sl: V restavraciji britansko the bill, ameriško the check.
words.note_it: Al ristorante britannico the bill, americano the check.
words.note_de: Im Restaurant britisch the bill, amerikanisch the check.

words.example_en: You need a bank account to get your wages.
words.example_sl: Za plačo potrebuješ bančni račun.
words.example_it: Per ricevere la paga ti serve un conto in banca.
words.example_de: Für deinen Lohn brauchst du ein Bankkonto.

words.example_en: The nearest cashpoint is in the post office in Keswick.
words.example_sl: Najbližji bankomat je na pošti v Keswicku.
words.example_it: Il bancomat più vicino è all'ufficio postale di Keswick.
words.example_de: Der nächste Geldautomat ist in der Post in Keswick.
words.note: Also called a cash machine; American an ATM.

words.example_en: Keep the receipt in case the boots don't fit.
words.example_sl: Shrani potrdilo o nakupu, če čevlji ne bodo prav.
words.example_it: Tieni lo scontrino, nel caso gli scarponi non vadano bene.
words.example_de: Heb den Kassenbon auf, falls die Stiefel nicht passen.
words.note: The p is silent: receipt sounds like "ri-SEET".
words.note_sl: P se ne izgovori: receipt se sliši "ri-SIT".
words.note_it: La p non si pronuncia: receipt si dice "ri-SIT".
words.note_de: Das p ist stumm: receipt klingt wie "ri-SIET".

words.example_en: Walkers get a ten per cent discount at the café.
words.example_sl: Pohodniki imajo v kavarni deset odstotkov popusta.
words.example_it: Gli escursionisti hanno uno sconto del dieci per cento al bar.
words.example_de: Wanderer bekommen im Café zehn Prozent Rabatt.

words.example_en: Only two pounds for this jumper? What a bargain!
words.example_sl: Samo dva funta za ta pulover? Kakšna ugodna kupčija!
words.example_it: Solo due sterline per questo maglione? Che affare!
words.example_de: Nur zwei Pfund für diesen Pullover? Was für ein Schnäppchen!

words.example_en: The village fête has a budget of five hundred pounds.
words.example_sl: Vaški sejem ima proračun petsto funtov.
words.example_it: La festa del paese ha un budget di cinquecento sterline.
words.example_de: Das Dorffest hat ein Budget von fünfhundert Pfund.

words.example_en: Somebody handed in a wallet they found on the bus.
words.example_sl: Nekdo je oddal denarnico, ki jo je našel na avtobusu.
words.example_it: Qualcuno ha consegnato un portafoglio trovato sull'autobus.
words.example_de: Jemand hat eine Brieftasche abgegeben, die er im Bus gefunden hat.

words.example_en: Maggie keeps her bus pass in her purse.
words.example_sl: Maggie hrani avtobusno izkaznico v denarnici.
words.example_it: Maggie tiene l'abbonamento dell'autobus nel borsellino.
words.example_de: Maggie hat ihren Busausweis in der Geldbörse.
words.note: In Britain a purse is a small bag for money; in America a purse is a handbag.
words.note_sl: V Britaniji je purse majhna denarnica; v Ameriki je purse torbica.
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna purse è il borsellino; in America è la borsetta.
words.note_de: In Großbritannien ist purse die Geldbörse; in Amerika eine Handtasche.

words.example_en: I'll pay you back on Friday, when I get my wages.
words.example_sl: Denar ti bom vrnil v petek, ko dobim plačo.
words.example_it: Ti restituisco i soldi venerdì, quando prendo la paga.
words.example_de: Ich zahle es dir am Freitag zurück, wenn ich meinen Lohn bekomme.

words.example_en: Don't waste your money on souvenirs, buy some good boots!
words.example_sl: Ne zapravljaj denarja za spominke, kupi si dobre čevlje!
words.example_it: Non sprecare soldi in souvenir, comprati dei buoni scarponi!
words.example_de: Verschwende dein Geld nicht für Andenken, kauf dir gute Stiefel!

words.example_en: They used their savings to repair the roof.
words.example_sl: S prihranki so popravili streho.
words.example_it: Hanno usato i risparmi per riparare il tetto.
words.example_de: Sie haben ihre Ersparnisse für die Reparatur des Dachs verwendet.
